javascript: Optional: @ggds/js shows the Show button, switches the field between hidden and visible, tells screen readers which it is, and hides the password again when the form is sent. Without it, a normal password field.
classes: On the field: a password with a Show button.
The input and the button, side by side, wrapping on a narrow screen.
The password input, as well as .ggds-input.
The Show / Hide button, as well as .ggds-button--secondary. Hidden until the script runs.
astro:
---
import PasswordInput from '@ggds/astro/PasswordInput.astro';
---
<PasswordInput id="password" name="password" label="Password" />
django:
class SignInForm(forms.Form):
    password = forms.CharField(widget=forms.PasswordInput)  # GGDSFormRenderer adds the Show button
tests: password input: Show reveals the password, says so, and hides it again when the form is sent
